time_unit: RTL model clock cycles; no physical frequency conversion
reset_reason: independent complete trials start from the same constructed ordinary initial state; no resets/flushes inside a trial
source_fixture_kind: generated finite exact payload, not native traffic or naturally concurrent arrival

mapping.logical_owner: single finite backend owner; hardware requester identity does not create separate isolation demand
mapping.allocation_limit: Simulation address-range reservation only. No real physical hugepage allocation is claimed. 2MiB is largest leaf inside the frozen aligned 2MiB authorized coverage; a 1GiB leaf would require additional authorized/reserved coverage.
mapping.translation_state: Same normal initial constructed state at reset, first-use walks charged; mapping retained throughout phase. No per-copy flush, forced misses, private tags or padding. Legal retained warm/all-hit operation remains an ordinary alternative; first-use-only losses cannot justify a recurrent interference claim.

hardware_budget.consequence: Do not call parallel equal active-resource single-DMA: same provisioned platform, more active engine resources. Report active buffers/FIFO/in-flight and configuration cost separately; no resize/partition changes.

parameters.behavioral_DDR_R_return_queue: single ordered queue; capacity16 AR requests

cost_boundaries.common_ready: all active source/descriptor metadata known, before any active-engine mode MMIO; table/payload construction and preissue reset/quiet recorded separately
cost_boundaries.mode_config_sequence: initialize active engines in engine0,engine1 order before first launch. Thus parallel F0 pays 15 extra mode-configuration cycles before first issue; this is included in readiness latency and is not an IOMMU attribution.
cost_boundaries.required_MMIO: each actual request, ack and return in events.csv. prepare three exact fields, trigger NEXT only after prior matched DONE, round-robin public DONE polls. MMIO occupancy overlaps hardware work and must not be added to T_all as if disjoint.
cost_boundaries.hardware_ready: real backend response after independently conserved final R/W/B; retrospective, not an application-consumption timestamp
cost_boundaries.drain: T_all_quiet minus T_all_data retains public final observation/drain
cost_boundaries.software_phase: headers/used, source reuse, original-cookie consume, B return and teardown happen in logical sequence after global quiet; host work does not advance RTL clock and has no modeled application latency
cost_boundaries.host_measurements: run.json separate construction/execution-with-observers/postquiet/checker wall-time; instrumentation only, excludes later JSON output and destructor; execution.json external full process receipts
cost_boundaries.unassigned_host_interval: initial raw snapshot writes and reset/initial-quiet are outside construction and execution buckets; total lifecycle includes them. No fabricated per-component CPU cost.
cost_boundaries.checker: independent Python check is postprocess, no hardware input or cycle feedback

measured.build_reason: initial read-only taps; added serialized R/W LAST evidence before any run; final incremental build then all cases once
measured.second_checker_reason: root required packet-complete peer progress distinct from completed DMA span bytes; recomputed from unchanged raw traces, no RTL rerun

unmeasured: native DPDK/vhost application latency or throughput
limitations: test-only cfg master bypasses production CPU/config interconnect
reduced system wrapper includes only two DMA and idle synthetic CPU rather than all board masters
ASSERTS_OFF inherited; explicit C++ protocol, identity, byte and conservation checks active
success-path only; no bus-error/timeout/quarantine recovery claim
cold first use charged; warm/resident alternative not measured; first-use observation is not recurrent unavoidable loss
physical budget is provisioned equally; active engine resources differ
